title: 第11章 和圣女朝夕相处第12章 人和人的信任呢
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
叶云一步三晃的走出来，让人怀疑是不是会随时嗝屁。
而后，他艰难地抬起手来，亮出掌心的圣火丹。
“幸，幸不辱命。”
接过叶云手中的圣火丹，雪岚愣了一下，在端详一番后震惊道。
“居然还是无暇品质的圣火丹？！”
她难以置信的抬起头，望着叶云问道。
“你炼丹之术这么厉害？”
可当看着叶云摇摇欲坠，仿佛随时要死掉的样子，她不由扶了一下关切道。
“你……还好吧？”
“没事，就是方才消耗过大，休息一会就好了。”
叶云摇了摇头，旋即艰难的抬头道。
“倒是你，快些服药吧，免得耽误伤势。”
原本对他极其厌恶的雪岚，看着他这虚弱至极还关心自己的样子，脸上的冰冷不由褪去几分。
想着无论如何，对方也相当于救了自己一命，于是便还算温柔的，将他扶到刚收拾好的床上。
“我这不急，你先在这坐会吧。”
“嗯……多谢。”
叶云点了下头，在她的搀扶下坐在床上。
这演技的真实度，恐怕就是奥斯卡影帝也得靠边站。
见此情形，雪岚看着叶云淡淡道。
“这次的事情之后，你我之间，就算是恩怨两清了。”

按照她的意思，看来上次将其堂妹淘汰之事翻篇了。
叶云对此倒不在意，只是淡淡一笑。
“既然如此，那要下次还有需要的丹药，尽管来废丹房找我。”
他这话中的意思，可再明显不过了。
雪岚脸上刚褪去的红晕，再一次浮现出来，当即瞪了眼略带羞耻的道。
“这种事情，没有下次！”
“啧啧……”
叶云也没争辩，只是笑而不语。
雪岚显然也不想，在这个话题上与他纠缠，当即将话题转移了下。
“话说回来，你这家伙炼丹之术那么厉害，为何还会在废丹房待着？”
哪怕是在古道圣地之中，能够炼制出无暇圣火丹的也不多。
content_en:
Ye Yun walked out with unsteady steps, making people wonder if he would burp at any time.
Then, he raised his hand with difficulty and showed the Holy Fire Pill in his palm.
"Fortunately, fortunately, I did not disgrace my life."
After taking the Holy Fire Pill from Ye Yun's hand, Xue Lan was stunned for a moment, and then said in shock after looking at it for a while.
"It's actually a Holy Fire Pill of flawless quality?!"
She raised her head in disbelief, looked at Ye Yun and asked.
"Are you so good at alchemy?"
But when she saw Ye Yun crumbling, as if he was about to die at any moment, she couldn't help but support him and said with concern.
"Are you... okay?"
"It's okay, it's just that I consumed too much just now, so I'll be fine after a while."
Ye Yun shook his head, then raised his head with difficulty and said.
"It's up to you to take the medicine quickly to avoid delaying the injury."
Xue Lan, who was originally extremely disgusted with him, couldn't help but lose some of the coldness on her face when she saw how weak he still cared about her.
Thinking that no matter what, the other party saved his life, he gently helped him to the bed that had just been made.
"I'm not in a hurry, just sit here for a while."
"Well...thank you."
Ye Yun nodded and sat on the bed with her support.
The realism of this acting skill would probably make even an Oscar winner have to step aside.
Seeing this situation, Xue Lan looked at Ye Yun and said calmly.
"After this incident, the grudges between you and me will be settled."
According to her, it seems that the last incident of eliminating her cousin has been repeated.
Ye Yun didn't care about this and just smiled lightly.
"In that case, if you need any elixirs next time, just come to me in the Abandoned Alchemy Room."
The meaning of his words couldn't be more obvious.
The blush that had just faded from Xue Lan's face resurfaced again, and she immediately glared and said with a hint of shame.
"There will be no next time for this kind of thing!"
"Tsk tsk..."
Ye Yun didn't argue, he just smiled and said nothing.
Xue Lan obviously didn't want to bother with him on this topic, so she immediately changed the subject.
"Speaking of which, if you are so good at alchemy, why are you still staying in the useless alchemy room?"
Even in the Ancient Holy Land, there are not many people who can refine the Flawless Holy Fire Pill.
